note: The person's synthetic Data, written to the run's Data folder on every reset. Text files come from seed/home with {{class:ID}} expanded. Photos and the archive are generated. Every file's modification time is the lab epoch. 'provenance' states where each group of files came from: in words ('from'), as a row of the origin table in crates/crowbar-labels ('origin'), with any label the person raised it to after that ('raised_to'), the label and mark that gives ('label', 'mark'), and the attacks and tasks that use the files ('used_by'). A test in that crate, lab_provenance.rs, keeps the label and mark the same as the origin table. A path is one file, or 'Folder/*' for every file directly in a folder. Reset writes each file's label and mark to home.labels.json. A file no group covers gets no record, which is an unknown origin.
